text: Her smile appears to change depending on where you look — da Vinci used sfumato shading with no hard lines around the mouth
No eyebrows or lashes — either the fashion of Renaissance Florence, or lost over centuries of cleaning and restoration
The left and right backgrounds don’t align — the horizon sits at different heights, creating a subtle sense of unease
Gently folded hands convey calm and virtue — a deliberate pose that was a Renaissance convention for portraying respectable women
